description: This file implements WiFi network scanning functionalities for the WifiManager component, including event handling, asynchronous SSID retrieval, filtering, and interaction with the IARM bus.

classes.name: WifiManagerScan
classes.description: Handles WiFi scanning operations, event registration, filtering, and processing of SSID data.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Registers event handlers for WiFi SSID availability events.

methods.name: Deinitialize
methods.description: Unregisters event handlers for WiFi SSID availability events.

methods.name: startScan
methods.description: Starts a WiFi scan, optionally filtering by SSID and frequency, and choosing between incremental or full scan.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsync
methods.description: Requests an asynchronous list of available SSIDs via IARM bus.

methods.name: getAvailableSSIDsAsyncIncr
methods.description: Requests an incremental asynchronous list of SSIDs, with results delivered in stages.

methods.name: stopScan
methods.description: Stops an ongoing incremental WiFi scan.

methods.name: iarmEventHandler
methods.description: Handles WiFi SSID list events from the IARM bus, parses JSON data, applies filters, and forwards results.

methods.name: applyFilter
methods.description: Filters SSID list based on regex match for SSID and frequency.
